Variants.Content: After the death of her husband, the situation of the widow depended on the dowry, the issue, the goodwill of the family and the lord. A high-ranking woman may be able to take charge of the manor and take care of the heirs, but a poor woman may lose the choice between debt and remarriage; in addition to grief, they also have to face the ledger.
